official_finding.summary: The NTSB determined the probable cause of the San Pedro Bay Pipeline rupture was the proximity of established anchorage positions to the pipeline: on 25 January 2021 a strong cold front drove the containerships MSC DANIT and Beijing to drag anchor, and their anchors struck, displaced (~105 ft) and damaged the pipeline. Undetected, fatigue cracks grew until the pipeline leaked ~9 months later, on 1 October 2021. The volume released was worsened by Beta Offshore's insufficient controller training and failure to shut in the line promptly.

responsible_parties.name: MSC DANIT
responsible_parties.role: anchor strike NTSB names as the initiating event

responsible_parties.name: Beijing
responsible_parties.role: second containership that dragged anchor and contacted the pipeline in the same 25 Jan 2021 storm

responsible_parties.name: Amplify Energy Corp. / Beta Offshore
responsible_parties.role: pipeline operator; delayed shutdown increased the volume released

official_finding.source_name: NTSB Marine Investigation Report MIR-24-01, 'Anchor Strike of Underwater Pipeline and Eventual Crude Oil Release'
official_finding.caveat: The anchor strikes preceded the oil release by ~8-9 months. No vessel was transiting or the proximate source at detection time (2 Oct 2021). The source at detection time is fixed infrastructure — the pipeline itself. MIR-24-01's casualty fact table gives the location as 33°34.20' N, 118°7.26' W, 4.75 nm off Huntington Beach. The ~33.66 N figure that circulated earlier was not the NTSB coordinate.

naap_result.origin_summary: Trace seeded from det-01 (2.64 km², the only oil feature). Origin cloud centred at 33.59454 N, 118.05190 W after a ~6.2 km median rewind, peak 0.2 km from the centroid. r50 1.35 km, r90 2.46 km (ensemble precision). Release window measured by convergence: 2021-10-01 17:41Z to 19:58Z. Wind share 0.38. The origin peak is 6.75 km from NTSB's casualty location (33°34.20' N, 118°7.26' W), which lies outside the origin grid. Stage 3: 106 in region → 75 in window → 5 plausible, abstained on vessels (top two inseparable). The declared San Pedro Bay Pipeline scored below the 0.25 infrastructure floor, so no infrastructure finding.
